PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assesses patient care needs by gleaning hospital records and/or referral provided information for information necessary to determine the appropriateness of referral and to initiate patient records.
  • Identifies educational needs for patients/significant others.
  • Adheres to skilled service/homebound regulations of payers.
  • Plans for patient care by ensuring that information regarding pending referrals is passed on to nursing supervisors, clinical supervisor or rehab services, and others as necessary in a timely manner.
  • Coordinates with nursing supervisors, clinical supervisor or rehab services, and others in initiating care.
  • Seeks appropriate orders in planning multidisciplinary care.
  • Completes evaluation of care by reassessing patients systematically to identify progress and trends that require intervention; this may include seeing the rehospitalized patient and/or reviewing his/her record.
  • Communicates with supervisor regarding the cases he/she is managing while awaiting the initiation of care.
  • Assesses and discerns environmental factors which are hazardous and/or unsafe and responds according to policy and agency expectation.
  • Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing or education equivalency for licensing

  • Frequent lifting/carrying and pushing/pulling objects weighing 0-25 lbs.

  • Frequent use of vision and depth perception for distances near (20 inches or less) and far (20 feet or more) and to identify and distinguish colors.
  • Frequent use of smell to detect/recognize odors.
  • Frequent use of hearing to receive oral communication, distinguish body sounds and/or hear alarms, malfunctioning machinery, etc.
  • Occasional lifting/carrying and pushing/pulling objects weighing 25-50 lbs.
  • Occasional lifting/moving of patients.
  • Occasional bending, stooping, kneeling, squatting, twisting, gripping and repetitive foot/leg and hand/arm movements.
  • Occasional driving.
  • Rare crawling and running.

Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.

Position Overview:

The Assistant Vice President, Data is a senior enterprise data leadership role within Vibrant's Data Pillar, responsible for unifying and leading Vibrant's full data capability - spanning analytics and reporting, data science, machine learning, and AI. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader serves as the single accountable executive for Vibrant's entire data function during an intentional consolidation phase designed to build integrated data maturity before the function expands into two distinct leadership tracks.

In this role, the AVP, Data ensures that Vibrant's analytics infrastructure, machine learning programs, AI adoption, and data governance operate as a coherent ecosystem. The AVP partners with program leadership and staff as well as Vibrant's executive team to deliver data products, predictive models, and responsible AI capabilities that directly improve outcomes for people in crisis.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead an integrated data strategy spanning analytics & reporting, data science, machine learning, and AI - aligned to Vibrant's goals and program priorities. Serve as Vibrant's senior data executive: advising the CTO, executive leadership, and the Board on data capabilities, AI adoption, and investment priorities.
  • Build and manage the departmental roadmap, establishing the organizational architecture and roal definitions. Lead Vibrant's data governance council responsibilities, including oversight of data standards, KPI frameworks, and program data sharing requirements.
  • Own budget planning, tracking, and forecasting for the Data function, ensuring spend aligns with approved FY budgets, funding stream requirements, and grant compliance obligations
  • Manage the AI use approval pipeline with internal and external leadershipo: preparing documentation, use case justifications, and responsible AI assessments for all AI/ML deployments under the cooperative agreement.
  • Lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of Vibrant's enterprise analytics and reporting platform, supporting operational, compliance, and strategic reporting needs across programs and corporate functions.
  • Ensure delivery of program-required reporting, including automated dashboards for network operational and quality metrics, crisis contact center performance reporting, and federally mandated data submissions.
  • Design and deliver executive dashboards and performance scorecards for Vibrant's leadership team, Board of Directors, and crisis center network.
  • Own the data governance framework for reporting outputs: data definitions, lineage documentation, and quality assurance protocols.
  • Evaluate and implement BI and analytics tooling (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) to modernize Vibrant's reporting infrastructure.
  • Lead Vibrant's response to audit and compliance data requests, including federal OIG reviews and GAO inquiries.
  • Champion data accessibility and health equity analytics across Vibrant's programs, ensuring disaggregated reporting by race, ethnicity, geography, and other equity dimensions.
  • Oversee development and deployment of machine learning models across use cases including crisis risk stratification, call routing optimization, quality assurance automation, NLP-driven conversation analytics, and population health analytics.
  • Establish responsible AI governance frameworks, including bias auditing, model explainability, and ethical review protocols appropriate for behavioral health contexts and required by the program.
  • Partner with the peers to advance the research agenda, maintain scientific standards, and translate research findings into production-ready models.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies - including large language models and generative AI - with appropriate rigor, human-in-the-loop safeguards, and program approvals for mission-critical applications.
  • Ensure all AI/ML systems meet regulatory requirements.
  • Build, develop, and retain a high-performing data organization spanning Analytics & Reporting, Data Science, ML Engineering, MLOps, AI Ethics, Data Quality, and Data Governance functions.
  • Manage and mentor direct reportsManage the analytics and data science product roadmap in partnership with internal teams, ensuring data investments are sequenced against program stakeholder needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Represent Vibrant's data and AI capabilities in external partner engagements, grant applications, and public health research contexts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Executive-level experience defining and executing integrated data strategies spanning analytics, business intelligence, data science, and AI within complex, mission-driven organizations.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise analytics, BI platform architecture, and modern data stack technologies (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, Tableau/Power BI/Looker).
  • Strong command of data science and machine learning: proficiency in Python-based ML ecosystems (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face), end-to-end model lifecycle management, NLP, and responsible AI.
  • Proven ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing multidisciplinary data teams across analytics, data science, and ML engineering functions.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing responsible AI frameworks - bias detection, model explainability, and ethical review - in high-stakes, human-centered environments.
  • Strong understanding of HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, federal data governance requirements, and AI compliance in health and human services contexts.
  • Ability to translate complex data and AI concepts into clear, actionable insights for executive leadership, Board members, federal partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance teams to govern and deploy data and AI capabilities responsibly.
  • Demonstrated commitment to advancing health equity analytics, inclusive data practices, and mission-aligned AI adoption.

Required Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in analytics, data science, or data leadership roles, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity with direct accountability for both analytics and data science or ML functions.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field required; Master's degree or higher preferred (Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Public Health, or related field).
  • Demonstrated experience leading programs, teams, or operational units across multiple data disciplines, with accountability for project execution, team performance, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Deep expertise in BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent), modern data stack technologies (dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery), and ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, or equivalent).
  • Proven track record building enterprise data infrastructure and applied AI/ML programs in complex, regulated environments.
  • Experience in mission-driven, nonprofit, healthcare, government, or other highly regulated environments, with familiarity in compliance-driven reporting and data governance frameworks preferred.
  • Experience with SAMHSA-funded programs, federal cooperative agreements, or similarly regulated grant environments strongly preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position at least 50% of the time
  • Will constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer
  • Will frequently communicate over video calls with internal and external stakeholders

We determine base pay through a comprehensive review of skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and other relevant factors. The range listed reflects the compensation parameters for the role and does not represent the full compensation package. A complete overview of compensation and benefits will be provided by the Talent Acquisition team during the hiring process.

Full time employees will be eligible for excellent comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, supplemental income insurance, employer paid disability insurance, employer paid life insurance, pre-tax FSA for medical and dependent care, and 401K available.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they are able to perform every task in the job description. About the Role

This role carries a dual commercial mandate: leading Radiometer’s growth strategy across West Africa while developing funded and turnkey healthcare opportunities across the wider African region.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business development, channel leadership and complex project management with strong knowledge of African healthcare markets. The role requires the ability to build trusted relationships with government institutions, funding organizations, healthcare networks, distributors and turnkey providers—translating complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable growth for Radiometer.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership – West Africa

  • Develop and execute Radiometer’s commercial strategy to accelerate portfolio growth across West Africa.

  • Deliver annual sales, revenue, profitability, margin and market-share objectives.

  • Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities across government, private healthcare, laboratory and institutional markets.

  • Drive customer engagement through value-based selling and consultative commercial approaches.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for key customers and healthcare networks.

  • Analyze market dynamics, competitor activity, healthcare funding trends and emerging opportunities to shape regional growth priorities.

  • Monitor channel-partner performance through structured business reviews, KPI tracking and market feedback.

  • Identify performance gaps within the channel network and recommend corrective actions, partner development plans or alternative partners when required to improve market coverage and business results.

Funded and Turnkey Project Development – Africa

  • Lead the identification, qualification and pursuit of funded healthcare projects across Africa.

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with:

    • International funding organizations

    • NGOs and implementing partners

    • Multilateral organizations

    • Ministries of Health

    • Government procurement agencies

    • Turnkey healthcare providers

  • Monitor donor-funded opportunities, public tenders, grants and strategic healthcare initiatives.

  • Develop project-pursuit strategies and coordinate bid and proposal activities.

  • Own Radiometer’s strategic relationship framework for turnkey partners, ensuring clear account ownership, stakeholder mapping, engagement cadence, opportunity prioritization and executive alignment.

  • Act as Radiometer’s central commercial owner for turnkey-provider relationships across the EEATR region.

  • Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure Radiometer is engaged early, appropriately specified and consistently represented throughout complex healthcare infrastructure projects.

  • Build long-term relationships with turnkey providers to understand their project pipelines and influence solution design at an early stage.

  • Position Radiometer as a preferred partner for blood gas and acute-care diagnostic solutions within major turnkey healthcare projects.

  • Support contract negotiations and commercial agreements related to funded and turnkey opportunities.

  • Establish Radiometer as a trusted diagnostic-solutions partner for major healthcare projects across Africa.

Channel-Partner Management

  • Recruit, develop and manage high-performing distributors and channel partners across assigned territories.

  • Implement channel-excellence programs and structured performance-management processes.

  • Conduct regular business reviews, forecasting sessions and capability-development initiatives.

  • Ensure channel partners maintain the technical and commercial capabilities required to represent Radiometer effectively.

  • Establish clear targets, performance indicators and accountability measures for distributor partners.

  • Drive improved market coverage, opportunity development and customer support through the channel network.

Stakeholder and Relationship Management

  • Build trusted relationships with key healthcare decision-makers, influencers and clinical stakeholders.

  • Engage senior stakeholders across government institutions, donor organizations, healthcare groups and laboratory networks.

  • Represent Radiometer at industry events, conferences and relevant stakeholder forums.

  • Act as a strategic advisor to customers by understanding their clinical, operational and financial challenges.

  • Develop strong relationships with key turnkey providers, implementing partners and funding organizations.

  • Strengthen Radiometer’s access to major projects through early engagement, partner advocacy and consistent executive-level alignment.

Project Execution and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Sales, Service, Applications, Marketing, Finance, Regulatory and Supply Chain teams to support successful project delivery.

  • Manage opportunities from initial identification and qualification through contracting, implementation, commissioning and customer acceptance.

  • Coordinate cross-functional project activities and maintain alignment around timelines, responsibilities and customer expectations.

  • Identify and manage project-related risks while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.

  • Drive customer satisfaction, retention and long-term partnership growth.

  • Ensure clear internal communication and executive visibility throughout major strategic pursuits.

Forecasting and Business Planning

  • Develop accurate sales forecasts, annual business plans and well-qualified opportunity pipelines.

  • Maintain strong pipeline discipline, including clear opportunity stages, values, timelines, risks and next actions.

  • Manage budgets and resources effectively to optimize commercial performance.

  • Deliver regular business reviews and performance reports to regional leadership.

  • Track progress against sales, profitability, market-share and strategic project objectives.

  • Ensure compliance with Danaher policies, industry regulations and ethical business practices.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare or a related discipline.

  • A postgraduate qualification in Business Management or an MBA would be advantageous.

Professional Experience

  • At least seven years of successful commercial experience within medical diagnostics, medical devices or the broader healthcare industry.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing business across African markets, particularly West Africa.

  • Proven track record of delivering profitable sales growth and achieving commercial targets.

  • Strong experience working with:

    • Donor-funded healthcare programs

    • International funding agencies

    • Implementing partners

    • NGOs

    • Government healthcare institutions

    • Ministries of Health

    • Turnkey healthcare providers

  • Experience leading large-scale healthcare projects, tenders or turnkey opportunities is highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated experience managing distributors and indirect sales channels across multiple countries.

  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles, public procurement processes and stakeholder environments within African healthcare markets.

Critical Competencies

Commercial Excellence

  • Strategic sales and territory planning

  • Business development and market expansion

  • Opportunity qualification and pipeline management

  • Value-based and consultative selling

  • Commercial negotiation and influencing

  • Strategic-account development

  • Distributor and channel-performance management

  • Financial and commercial awareness

Project and Stakeholder Management

  • Funded-project identification and development

  • Tender and proposal management

  • Complex project-pursuit planning

  • Cross-functional leadership

  • Executive stakeholder engagement

  • Customer and partner relationship management

  • Contract negotiation and risk management

  • Ability to navigate complex institutional environments

Personal Attributes

  • Results-oriented with a strong focus on execution.

  • Strategic thinker capable of translating market insights into practical growth plans.

  • Proactive, entrepreneurial and comfortable creating opportunities in developing markets.

  • Highly organized, with strong planning and prioritization skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Adaptable and resilient within complex and changing environments.

  • Collaborative and able to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

  • Strong sense of ownership, integrity and accountability.

  • Culturally aware and effective in diverse, multinational environments.

Language Requirements

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Fluent French, written and spoken—mandatory.

  • Proficiency in additional African languages would be advantageous.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be assessed through:

  • Achievement of annual sales, profitability and margin targets.

  • Growth of Radiometer’s market share across West Africa.

  • Value and quality of funded and turnkey projects secured across Africa.

  • Strength and maturity of Radiometer’s strategic relationships with turnkey providers.

  • Early access to major healthcare infrastructure projects and repeat inclusion in strategic opportunities.

  • Expansion, capability and performance of the distributor and channel-partner network.

  • Customer satisfaction, retention and long-term account development.

  • Forecast accuracy and quality of the commercial opportunity pipeline.

  • Successful execution of strategic healthcare projects.

  • Compliance with Radiometer and Danaher policies and ethical business standards.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a commercially driven healthcare professional who has successfully developed business across African healthcare markets and understands the donor-funded healthcare ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong network across Ministries of Health, funding organizations, implementing partners, government institutions and turnkey providers. They will combine strategic business-development expertise with the commercial discipline and stakeholder-management capabilities required to convert large, complex opportunities into sustainable growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for an entrepreneurial commercial leader who wants to shape Radiometer’s growth across West Africa while contributing to transformative healthcare projects throughout Africa.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

Senior Director, Account Executive Operations (Remote-Eligible)

The Senior Director, Account Executive Operations provides executive leadership and strategic vision for the operational business support of our most critical partners. This role is fundamentally about organizational leadership—building scalable structures, defining the operating rhythm, and deeply investing in the coaching and development of a multi-layered team. As a leader of leaders, you will design the frameworks that guide daily operations, drive enterprise-wide process improvements, and serve as the executive sponsor for complex partner relationships.

We are seeking a highly structured, transformative leader who thrives on mentoring teams, creating clarity out of ambiguity, and fostering a high-performance culture across the operations organization.

Core Responsibilities

  • Executive Leadership & Coaching: Direct, mentor, and coach a multi-layered team of operational leaders (Managers and Directors). Foster a culture of continuous feedback, prioritize leadership development, and build robust succession plans.

  • Organizational Design & Structure: Design, implement, and govern comprehensive operational frameworks and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Bring rigorous structure to the department by establishing clear roles, responsibilities, and standardized workflows.

  • Strategic Partner Management: Serve as the executive sponsor and ultimate point of escalation for the network’s top-tier, highest-impact strategic partners, managing relationships at the C-suite level.

  • Operational Excellence & Risk Mitigation: Define the overarching strategy for mitigating operational gaps and system risks. Oversee the deployment of enterprise-wide initiatives to eliminate failure modes and ensure absolute compliance and documentation integrity.

  • Cross-Functional Vision: Champion the full life-cycle of complex, cross-functional transformations. Partner with executive stakeholders across Product, Tech, and Sales to sponsor system enhancements, tool rollouts, and long-term capability building.

  • Performance Strategy: Define the key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics for the entire department. Leverage executive-level dashboards to drive continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and resource alignment with corporate goals.

  • Change Management: Lead the organization through periods of growth and change, ensuring comprehensive training, change readiness, and adoption strategies are effectively executed.

  • Client Engagement: This is a highly visible, client-facing executive role requiring approximately 25-30% travel.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification

  • At least 10 years of account management, operations, or relationship management experience within the financial services or payments industry

  • At least 8 years of people leadership and performance management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

  • 12+ years of account management, operations, or relationship management experience within the financial services or payments industry

  • 10+ years of senior leadership experience, specifically focused on coaching leaders, organizational design, and scaling complex operational teams

  • Demonstrated expertise in strategic planning, capability building, and managing executive-level client relationships within the South American market

  • 5+ years of change management experience

We’re excited to expand our team as our impact and coverage areas continue to grow. Our team members are dedicated and passionate about our mission of making exceptional, judgment-free care for addiction more accessible.

We believe everyone deserves respectful, effective treatment for substance use disorder at the moment they're ready for it. We're looking for driven and compassionate individuals who share this goal. Join us in reducing stigma, saving lives, and changing the way addiction is treated in America.

Workit Health is seeking a remote Senior Total Rewards Analyst (Sr. Pay & Tax Analyst) to join the HR team. The successful candidate will have owned payroll operations and leave administration for a company of a similar size, be an expert in federal, state and local pay and leave laws (FMLA/ADA/PFL) in the US, have worked previously with complex tax operations common to a dispersed (remote) workforce, and have experience supporting total rewards and benefits programs.

  • Own and optimize full-cycle payroll, tax, and leave administration operations

  • Provide excellent customer service to Workit’s employees in all matters and all communication formats (Slack, email, verbal, Jira, etc.)
  • Drive strategy and resolution for complex multi-state pay and tax compliance issues
  • Monitor and process department mail digitally sent from our physical offices
  • Lead special pay, tax, and registration projects related to new state expansion efforts
  • Own equity administration in Carta and serve as a senior point of contact to assist with employee benefits programs as needed
  • Other pay, tax, and people services duties as assigned

  • 2+ years of experience being the primary payroll point of contact

raw.description:
Job Title:

Senior Manager / Director, Utility Engineering

Department:

Design and Construction

Division:

Data Center

Reports To:

Head of Technical Services and Utilities

Location:

US, Remote

Position Type:

Full-Time, Permanent

About Nscale

NScale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. NScale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

At NScale, our Design and Construction team plays a critical role in delivering data center facilities that are optimized for AI deployments.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an NScaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future

About the Role

● We are looking for a Senior Manager / Director of Utility Engineering to lead utility strategy and execution for our North America data center portfolio, with a focus on high‑density AI and GPU workloads.

● This leader will own end‑to‑end responsibility for securing, designing, and optimizing critical to support hyperscale, energy‑intensive AI compute at low cost and high reliability.

● You will be the primary technical owner for utility interfaces to our data centers with a focus on power, while also leading external partners to deliver projects on aggressive schedules.

● You will lead technical scope development and decision-making for behind-the-meter and utility-scale generation strategies, including conceptual through detailed design oversight, constructability, operability, and commissioning readiness.

● You will partner closely with development, design, operations, energy, and finance teams to deliver utility solutions that meet aggressive capacity, sustainability, and cost objectives across multiple markets.

● The position title and level will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)

Utility Strategy and Planning

  • Develop and own the long‑term utility strategy to support high‑density AI / GPU data centers across existing and new regions.
  • Evaluate and select sites based on grid capacity, reliability, renewable/low‑carbon options, interconnection queues, and regulatory constraints.
  • Build and maintain load forecasts based on AI / GPU growth scenarios and translate them into concrete utility capacity plans.
  • Develop power supply strategies that include both grid supply and on-site/behind-the-meter generation, evaluating trade-offs across reliability, schedule, fuel availability, emissions, and total cost of ownership.

Grid and Utility Engagement

  • Lead technical and commercial engagements with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, transmission owners, and large energy providers from early‑stage site diligence through energization.
  • Negotiate and manage interconnection agreements, service agreements, and tariffs in partnership with legal, regulatory, and energy procurement teams.
  • Track and influence grid upgrade timelines and constraints that impact data center development schedules.

Power Generation Strategy, Design, and Delivery

  • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for on-site power generation used to support data center capacity, schedule acceleration, and resilience.
  • Lead generation plant concept development through design completion, including architecture decisions and design basis for:
    • Generation technology selection (e.g., reciprocating engines, turbines, dual-fuel strategies where applicable)
    • Electrical topology and one-lines (medium voltage distribution, paralleling, synchronization, islanding, black start concepts as applicable)
    • Protection and controls philosophy (relaying, coordination, fault duty, grounding, synchronization, load sharing)
    • Integration with UPS/BESS/microgrid controllers and operational modes (grid-parallel, island, peak shaving, backup)
  • Oversee generation interconnection and utility coordination for behind-the-meter and/or utility-parallel operation, including studies, compliance, and operational requirements.
  • Drive equipment specification and procurement alignment for generator sets, switchgear, transformers, e-houses, controls systems, and balance-of-plant, with focus on long-lead risk and schedule certainty.
  • Support commissioning planning and field execution for generation systems, including performance verification, reliability demonstration, and handoff to operations.

Engineering, Design, and Standards

  • Define technical requirements and design standards for utility interfaces to high‑density GPU data centers (substations, transformers, switchgear, protection, metering, etc.).
  • Collaborate with internal and external design teams on one‑line diagrams, protection schemes, redundancy strategies (N, N+1, 2N), and fault / reliability studies.
  • Provide engineering leadership on integration of alternative or on‑site energy sources (renewables, storage, generators, microgrids, etc.) to improve resilience and cost.

Project Execution and Delivery

  • Serve as the utility engineering owner for a set of data center development projects from due diligence through energization.
  • Work closely with development, construction, and operations to align utility milestones with project schedules and capacity needs.
  • Visit sites as needed to support commissioning, troubleshooting, and design clarifications in the field.
  • Identify risks early (grid constraints, upgrade requirements, permitting, schedule slippage) and implement pragmatic mitigations.

Reliability, Performance, and Optimization

  • Ensure that utility designs meet or exceed reliability targets suitable for AI / GPU workloads with high power density and utilization.
  • Partner with operations, reliability, and capacity planning to monitor actual performance versus design assumptions and close gaps.
  • Continuously refine designs and standards to reduce losses, improve PUE / energy efficiency, and lower total cost of ownership.

Leadership and Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Lead internal and external partners, setting clear priorities and delivering against aggressive timelines.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for utility and grid topics, educating internal stakeholders including executives, development, finance, and product teams.
  • Communicate clearly with non‑technical stakeholders about utility risks, trade‑offs, and options.
  • Contribute to overall infrastructure strategy, including how power availability, cost, and carbon intensity influence data center and AI capacity roadmaps.

About You (Skills / Qualifications)

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in utility engineering, power systems, or grid‑connected infrastructure, with significant exposure to large‑scale data centers, industrial loads, or hyperscale cloud environments.
  • Deep understanding of transmission and distribution systems, interconnection processes, protection and controls, and utility planning.
  • Proven experience working directly with electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, or transmission owners on high‑capacity interconnections.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, multi‑stakeholder projects from concept through energization, ideally across multiple regions or countries.
  • Strong ability to interpret and produce electrical one‑lines, protection schemes, and system studies (load flow, short‑circuit, reliability).
  • Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical utility issues into clear business trade‑offs and recommendations for non‑engineers.
  • Demonstrated experience with power generation projects and/or generation plant electrical design, such as:
    • Designing or overseeing design of generation plant one-lines, MV distribution, synchronization/paralleling, protection and controls
    • Managing generator plant concept-to-commissioning delivery (including equipment specification and long-lead procurement)
    • Integrating generation with critical power architectures (UPS/BESS, islanding strategies, microgrid controls)

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Energy Systems, or similar.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent credential.
  • Experience with high‑density AI / GPU or HPC data centers, including unique power profiles and redundancy requirements.
  • Familiarity with renewable energy integration, energy storage, microgrids, and low‑carbon or sovereign energy strategies.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced growth environments or startups, where speed and execution are paramount.
  • International experience dealing with utilities, regulators, and grid operators in multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience with generator OEMs, EPCs, and commissioning providers for large-scale standby/prime power plants supporting mission-critical facilities

Equal Opportunities Statement

At NScale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range
$150,000—$230,000 USD

For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: Here.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We're looking for an Executive Communications and Content Manager to help our executive team and community show up in the market with sharp, distinctive points of view. This role is fundamentally a thought leadership and content role: you'll spend most of your time writing and creating content (blog posts, bylines, social content, video, and talking points) that carry our company narrative through the distinct voice of each spokesperson who delivers it.

You’ll work across Chainguard’s executive team, developing a narrative for each leader while keeping their storytelling aligned with broader company moments, launches, and campaigns. You'll also help extend that same thought leadership lens to our customers, highlighting their perspectives and insights as part of our content strategy. This is a role for a strong writer and storyteller who thrives on variety, juggles multiple voices and deadlines without losing quality, and knows how to translate complex topics into narratives that land with developer, security, and business audiences.

What you’ll do:

  • Executive thought leadership content: Develop and write blog posts, bylines, video, and long-form pieces that build our executives' individual points of view and reputations in the security and open source communities.
  • Customer thought leadership: Work with Chainguard customers to develop content that showcases their industry leadership and how they're using Chainguard.
  • Executive social presence: Manage and write social content for our executive team, turning ideas, moments, and company news into posts that sound authentically like each person.
  • Spokesperson prep: Shape narratives, talking points, and prep materials to help executives show up with a clear story at external engagements, such as podcasts, events, and webinars.
  • Narrative translation: Turn technical and strategic topics into stories that land with developer, security, and business audiences.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Work with Marketing, PR, and Events to make sure executive storytelling reinforces broader company narratives, launches, and campaigns.
  • Content operations: Own the external content calendar for each executive you support, and manage the process end to end.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in executive communications, public relations, content/brand storytelling, journalism, or a related writing-intensive role. In-house experience is a plus.
  • Ability to manage content across multiple executives, channels, and deadlines, without dropping the ball.
  • A storyteller's instinct: you can spot the narrative in a piece of news, a customer moment, or an executive's offhand idea, and turn it into content that resonates.
  • Excellent writing and messaging skills, with the ability to convey complex information in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Comfort operating with confidence around senior execs, including knowing when to push back or nudge them to keep things moving.
  • Proven success in cross-functional, highly collaborative roles.
  • Bonus: experience working in highly technical or developer-facing organizations.

On-Target Earnings: $127,650 - $161,000

Base Salary Range
$111,000—$140,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

40

Time Type

Full time

raw.description:
Build What Matters Most—Families, Futures, and Your Career

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day.  US Fertility, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the hope we inspire in our patients, the lives we help bring into the world, and the culture of excellence we foster across our organization.  We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care.  The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.

Opportunity Overview

We have an immediate opening for a New Patient Liaison to join our remote team at US Fertility.

  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM, one Sunday every 5 weeks on a rotating schedule for up to 4 hours
  • Compensation: $22.00 to $25.00 per hour (commensurate with experience)
  • Location Requirement: This is a remote position only open to candidates who reside and are authorized to work in the following states: New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, Florida, and Pennsylvania. We are unable to consider candidates outside of these states.

This role provides the opportunity to grow within a nationally respected organization while remaining closely connected to the patients and teams you support every day.

How You’ll Contribute

At US Fertility, collaboration is fundamental to how we work.  There is undeniable strength in numbers—and support is always within reach.  Whether collaborating with more than 200 highly respected physicians nationwide or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

In this role, the New Patient Liaison will:

  • Prioritize time to generate increased new patient appointments by performing over the phone prospective customer consultations and closing new business
  • Use a “soft sell” and empathetic approach to convert prospective customers into very satisfied customers by responding to questions and explaining in detail the features and benefits of choosing US Fertility
  • Coordinate with USF offices and supervisors to ensure a seamless transition for prospective customers referred to medical diagnosis and treatment, especially when unusual conditions are present
  • Prepare and report on the metrics on the inside sales results and make recommendations to the leadership team on how to improve processes and increase sales
  • Accurately maintain customer database that tracks all relevant program information, including individual progress of prospective customers
  • Notate all unusual circumstances and document conversations with the potential customers in the database to ensure that complete, current and accurate information is available to everyone in the department
  • Follow-up with all prospective customers

    What You’ll Bring

    We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

    Qualifications and Skills Include:

    • Bachelor’s degree required in Biology, Psychology, Sociology, or a related field.
    • Bilingual Spanish preferred.
    • Five years customer service experience with at least two-three years inside sales experience
    • Competency in active listening and relationship building, and ability to communicate with empathy
    • Ability to build deep personal connections with callers who may be very emotional about the challenges they face in their effort to build a family
    • Ability to communicate accurately and concisely
    • Excellent interpersonal and telephone skills. Bilingual would be plus
    • Ability to function in a self directed manner, organize work tasks and information efficiently, monitor quality/effectiveness, collaborate within and across teams and execute timely and accurate follow through.
    • Working knowledge of healthcare services/fertility is a plus

    More important than any single credential, however, is the right person.  Team members who are most successful at US Fertility embrace our mission, live our values, and remain committed to continuous improvement—for themselves, their colleagues, and the patients we serve.

    What We Offer

    US Fertility is proud to provide a competitive, comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team members—professionally and personally—across all employment types.

    Full-Time Employees (30+ hours/week)

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Tuition assistance and professional development support
    • Performance-based bonus opportunities
    • Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
    • Life and disability benefits
    • Fertility Discount Program
    • Employee wellness and recognition programs 

    Part-Time Employees

    • 401(k) with company match
    • Performance-based bonus opportunities
    • Employee wellness and recognition programs

    Per Diem Employees

    • 401(k) with company match
    • Employee wellness and recognition programs 

    Our Commitment to Inclusion and Opportunity

    US Fertility and its network partners believe that a diverse workforce is essential to fulfilling our mission of expanding patient access to the highest standards of fertility care.  We are committed to equitable and inclusive hiring practices that ensure our clinical and operational teams reflect and support the diverse communities and patients we serve. 

    Across our national footprint, US Fertility is a leader in offering clinical, administrative, and operational career opportunities at locations throughout the United States.  We are equally committed to developing individual strengths, promoting from within, and supporting long-term career growth.

    This is a moment of growth, innovation, and impact.  Take the next step in your career with US Fertility—and help shape the future of fertility care.

raw.description:
Overview

About ClickPay

ClickPay, a RealPage company, is a leading payment processing platform purpose-built for residential real estate. We power billions of dollars in rent, HOA dues, and property-related payments annually, connecting property management companies, homeowner associations, and millions of residents through a unified billing and payments experience. As part of RealPage, the industry's premier property management software provider, ClickPay sits at the intersection of fintech and proptech—modernizing how the residential real estate industry moves money.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a VP of Product Management & Strategic Initiatives to lead ClickPay's product organization and drive the company's highest-impact strategic programs. This is a dual-mandate leadership role: you will build and lead a team of four Product Managers responsible for new product features across the full product lifecycle, while personally owning key strategic initiatives that span the business—from monetization and payment network economics to enterprise partnerships and regulatory readiness.

You will operate in a cross-functional matrix organization, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Implementations, and Support to ensure products are not only well-built, but well-launched, well-adopted, and well-supported. The right candidate combines deep payments and fintech domain expertise with strong people leadership and the executive presence to influence senior stakeholders across ClickPay and RealPage.

Responsibilities

Product Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of four Product Managers, setting clear priorities, raising the bar on product craft, and building a high-performing product culture.
  • Own the product roadmap for new features and capabilities, balancing customer needs, revenue impact, platform scalability, and compliance requirements.
  • Drive the full product lifecycle—discovery, requirements definition, development partnership with Engineering, beta programs, launch, adoption, iteration, and end-of-life decisions.
  • Define and execute go-to-market strategies in partnership with Marketing and Sales, including positioning, pricing, packaging, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Establish and track product KPIs (adoption, transaction volume, authorization rates, revenue per unit, NPS) and use data to inform prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Transform the ways of working into adoption of AI based product management tools to change the velocity of product and engineering initiatives.
  • Launch of new features such as PayPal, Venmo, Cash App and other alternative payments into the product that will drive 10% growth in incremental revenue.

Strategic Initiatives

  • Lead the transformation of cross-functional strategic programs of company-wide importance—such as payment economics optimization (interchange, network tokenization, account updater), enterprise partnership enablement, wallet and alternative payment method expansion, and regulatory compliance readiness.
  • Serve as the connective tissue across Sales, Marketing, Implementations, and Support in a matrix organization—aligning stakeholders, removing blockers, and driving initiatives from business case to measurable outcome.
  • Prepare and present executive-level analyses, business cases, and operating review materials to ClickPay and RealPage leadership.
  • Represent product and strategy in enterprise client and partner conversations, supporting complex commercial negotiations with product expertise.
  • Monitor the competitive, regulatory, and payment network landscape (card brand rules, state-level fee legislation, NACHA requirements) and translate changes into product and business strategy.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • 15+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading and developing product managers.
  • Required: Deep domain expertise in payments and fintech—card processing, ACH, interchange economics, digital wallets, tokenization, payment gateways, and/or billing platforms.
  • Proven track record of taking products from concept through launch and scale, including hands-on ownership of go-to-market execution.
  • Demonstrated success leading strategic initiatives in a matrixed environment, influencing without direct authority across sales, marketing, operations, and support functions.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen—comfortable building unit economics models, sizing opportunities, and defending investment cases with data.
  • Executive-level communication skills: crisp writing, confident presentation, and the ability to distill complexity for senior audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in proptech, property management software, or residential real estate payments.
  • Familiarity with payment network programs and compliance frameworks (Visa/Mastercard interchange programs, PCI DSS, state surcharge and fee regulations).
  • Experience supporting enterprise partnership or M&A-driven client retention initiatives.

Why Join Us

You will own the product agenda for a category-leading payments platform at a pivotal moment of growth—with the resources and reach of RealPage behind you and the pace and ownership of a focused fintech business in front of you. This role offers direct exposure to executive leadership, meaningful P&L influence, and the opportunity to shape how an entire industry pays and gets paid.

RealPage is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $154,800.00 - USD $281,200.00 /Yr.

raw.title: Full Stack Engineer (Frontend Oriented) — Identity & Security
raw.excerpt: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users.
raw.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

About the Team

The Identity & Security team owns the front door to Binance. We build and operate the registration, login, and account security experience used by every one of our 300M+ users — social login, OAuth and third-party authorization, multi-factor authentication, passkeys and FIDO2, device management, account activity, and account closure.

We are currently building an in-house AI facial recognition security product for KYC verification and user safety, replacing our existing third-party vendor solution. This is a to-C product serving hundreds of millions of users, directly impacting account security and identity verification experience at scale.

Our work sits where three forces meet: enormous scale, strict security and regulatory constraints, and the reality that one extra verification step can block an attacker or lock out a legitimate user. We ship across web, mobile mini programs, and in-app webviews, and we publish the shared authentication libraries and SDKs that the rest of Binance builds on.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain the login, registration, and account security applications across web and mobile clients
  • Build the in-house AI facial recognition security product end to end — KYC verification, liveness detection, face matching — replacing the existing third-party vendor solution
  • Build authentication capabilities end to end: passkeys / FIDO2 (WebAuthn), authenticator apps, security keys, SMS and email verification, and biometric flows
  • Own the multi-factor authentication orchestration layer — verification strategy, step-up logic, and user-level customization — balancing security strength against completion rate with measurable outcomes
  • Collaborate closely with the AI algorithm team to integrate facial recognition, liveness detection, and other AI model capabilities into the product frontend and backend, building high-concurrency, low-latency online inference services
  • Maintain and evolve the shared security component and logic libraries consumed by multiple product applications, and the authentication SDKs published to teams across the company; take responsibility for bundle size, initialization behavior, and backward compatibility
  • Develop and operate the Node.js server-side layer: server-side rendering, route-level authentication guards, session validation and redirects, localized routing, and first-paint performance
  • Build and refine the BFF layer — aggregating upstream security services and turning raw error codes into results the frontend can consume and users can act on
  • Implement platform-specific behavior for web, mini program, and low-end device targets while keeping shared and platform-specific code cleanly separated
  • Drive engineering quality: unit and end-to-end test coverage, instrumentation and observability, build and local development experience
  • Use funnel and event data to find drop-off in login and verification flows, and drive optimization from evidence rather than intuition
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, risk, customer support, backend, iOS, and Android teams; independently own the end-to-end design and delivery of a sub-domain such as passkeys, MFA orchestration, or facial recognition verification

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience
  • 3–8 years of frontend or full stack engineering experience, including consumer-facing products taken from zero to one or evolved over multiple years
  • Strong web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, browser rendering, networking, caching, and performance optimization
  • Deep proficiency in React 18+ and TypeScript, with solid command of state management, data-fetching patterns, and complex multi-step form and flow orchestration
  • Production Node.js experience: server-side rendering or isomorphic applications, BFF layering, API aggregation and caching, and the ability to independently debug server-side runtime issues
  • A clear methodology for modeling complex flows — authentication and verification are highly branched, stateful, interruptible, and resumable, and need to be abstracted into testable, reusable models rather than nested conditionals
  • Solid engineering practice: modular architecture, component design, unit and E2E testing, CI/CD, and responsible judgment on breaking changes to shared libraries (versioning, staged rollout, rollback)
  • Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot, etc.) with practical experience incorporating them into daily development workflows
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing production issues, compatibility problems, and performance bottlenecks independently
  • Fluent in Mandarin, able to collaborate effectively with China-based teams
  • Effective communication in English within a distributed, cross-timezone, multi-team environment

Nice to have

  • Experience at AI / computer vision companies in business-side frontend or fullstack development
  • Hands-on experience in identity and authentication: WebAuthn / FIDO2 / passkeys, TOTP, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT and token lifecycle management, risk engines, or device fingerprinting
  • Experience building to-C security products, identity verification, or KYC-related products
  • Experience replacing third-party vendor solutions with in-house systems, ensuring smooth business transition
  • Knowledge of AI model engineering: model inference services, RAG systems, AI Agent architecture, or computer vision model integration
  • Cross-platform experience: mini programs, hybrid applications, and in-app webview bridging and debugging
  • Experience shipping shared component libraries or SDKs to third-party consumers — multi-entry bundling, tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and integration support
  • Internationalization and localization at scale: date and number formatting, RTL, and regional compliance differences
  • Background in finance, payments, or another high-security domain, with an understanding of the product trade-offs compliance imposes
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting, staged rollout, and A/B experimentation
  • Docker / Kubernetes / CI-CD pipeline experience

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

raw.excerpt: Say hello to HagertyHagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers.
raw.description:
Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! 

The Payroll Specialist serves as the subject matter expert for U.S. and international payroll operations, Workday payroll configurations, and payroll controls. Partnering closely with HR, Finance, and Systems teams to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing, deliver exceptional employee support, and drive continuous process improvement.

What you’ll do

Payroll Operations

  • Perform key activities necessary in processing payrolls with a high degree of accuracy and adherence to established controls and deadlines.
  • Coordinate with payroll team members using standard operating procedures, documented workflows, and quality checkpoints.
  • Administer imports of external pay files (e.g., benefits, deductions, incentive programs) and payroll inputs including EIBs; validate all transactions for accuracy and compliance.
  • Review and audit payroll inputs for employee data changes including but not limited to new hires, terminations, leaves of absence, compensation changes, shift differentials, retro calculations, and off-cycle payments.
  • Run audit reports, investigate anomalies, and prepare preliminary payroll reconciliations prior to finalizing payroll.
  • Audit payroll output to identify and resolve discrepancies within established payroll timelines.
  • Analyze root causes of manual payroll adjustments or checks and implement corrective actions to reduce recurring issues.
  • Ensure payroll processing complies with all federal, state/provincial regulations, company policies, and internal controls.
  • Perform post-production audits and data maintenance to prepare for upcoming payroll cycles.

Systems & Process Optimization

  • Completes user testing for system upgrades in partnership with HR Systems teams.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities for process optimization, automation, and improved control design to mitigate potential compliance risks.
  • Develop and maintain detailed payroll SOPs, process documentation, workflows, and reference materials to support standardization and scalability.
  • Create and maintain recurring payroll audit reports and dashboards to support data integrity, trend analysis, and compliance monitoring.

Employee Support & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as a primary subject matter resource for payroll inquiries from employees, HR business partners, and managers, ensuring timely and accurate issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with HR on complex pay scenarios including pay corrections, retro pay, leaves of absence, FMLA, and other special circumstances.
  • Partner with Finance to align payroll activities with accounting requirements, reconciliations, and reporting needs.
  • Partner with third-party vendors to maintain close communication regarding international payroll matters and collaborate on troubleshooting and resolving payroll issues in a timely and effective manner.
  • Support knowledge-sharing, and training within the payroll team to build depth of expertise.

Compliance, Controls & Reporting

  • Ensure payroll processes comply with federal and state/provincial tax laws, wage and hour regulations, and internal policy standards.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and reporting to support quarterly and year-end tax filings, audits, and financial reporting.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing documentation, responding to inquiries, and demonstrating process controls.
  • Monitor state-specific payout rules including final pay requirements and PTO payout compliance.

This might describe you

  • Extensive knowledge of the payroll function including preparation, balancing, internal control, and payroll taxes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software, especially Excel.
  • Proficient with HRIS and payroll software, preferably Workday and ADP solutions.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality with data and sensitive materials.
  • Ability to be flexible in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of multi-state payroll laws.
  • Excellent knowledge in implementation, custom reporting, and production problem resolution for Payroll.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and organization ability.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a cross functional team.

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

If you reside in the following jurisdictions: Illinois, Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Maryland, Minnesota, Nevada, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey, Cincinnati or Toledo, Ohio, Rhode Island, Washington, British Columbia, Canada please email  for compensation, comprehensive benefits and the perks that set us apart. 

At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference.  We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.
